title: Tối ưu luồng chọn bàn sang menu trên mobile
rootCause: Selecting a table only called the parent onSelect callback. On mobile the existing navigation therefore remained on the table tab, kept the desktop selected-table panel in the document and did not preserve the chosen table across reloads. The downstream menu, item option, cart and proof surfaces also retained fixed viewport sizing and desktop spacing.

persisted table id and code in session storage and restore only when the id still exists in the current table list
reused the existing mobile Menu navigation after table selection instead of adding a second route or state abstraction
hid the desktop selected-table side panel on mobile and added safe-area/dvh scaling for menu, item options, cart and proof branches
added regression coverage for selection persistence, restoration, stale cleanup and automatic menu continuation
